title: The frontend shows 'Save and add another' on every identification record, including a consignment of one animal; DR1 hides it when there is one animal and calls it 'Save and finish' on the last.

finding.frontend: The button inside the record loop reads 'Save and add another' whatever is left to enter, and three captured states now say so. On a line of one animal the counter reads 'Enter details for Bos taurus 1 of 1' and the button still invites the person to add another. On a line of two with one already saved the counter reads 'Enter details for Bos taurus 2 of 2' — this is the last animal there is — and the button still reads 'Save and add another'. Only when the last record is saved does the wording stop being wrong, and that is because the whole entry block goes: the page then shows the saved records and the sentence 'You have entered details for all 2 Bos taurus animals'. So the words never tell the person what pressing them will do next. The button is rendered with no condition of its own at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/_identification-card.njk:71-76.
finding.prototype: DR1 makes the in-panel button say what is actually left to do. Where the species has one animal there is no in-panel button at all and the page's own Save and continue captures the record; where more remain it reads 'Save and add another'; and on the last outstanding animal it reads 'Save and finish' (app/routes.js:1711-1722). The captured DR1 panel is two cattle with both outstanding, which is why it shows 'Save and add another'.
finding.difference: Make the in-card button reflect the records still to enter on that line: no button when the line's number of animals is one, 'Save and finish' when this is the last outstanding record, 'Save and add another' otherwise. The card view model already knows the cap and how many units are saved, so the count is to hand. Leave the page-level buttons alone — they are the journey's own pattern and a separate concern.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a DR1 species panel for a single animal that renders an in-panel save button, or a DR1 panel on its last outstanding animal whose button still reads 'Save and add another'.
finding.correction: Claimed the button 'is always there' and is 'rendered unconditionally'. It is not unconditional: _identification-card.njk:26-77 renders the at-maximum message instead of the whole entry block — counter, fields and button together — once the line holds as many records as animals, so the button disappears at that point. What is unconditional is the wording, and the fact that the button accompanies every entry form regardless of how many records remain, which is what the finding is actually about. Frontend slot reworded; the finding stands. DR1's three states are confirmed in source at app/routes.js:1707-1723 — showSaveButton is false when totalAnimals <= 1, the text is 'Save and finish' when exactly one record is outstanding and 'Save and add another' otherwise — and the single-animal case is genuinely handled by the page-level Save and continue, which calls saveActiveAnimalIdentifiersFromBody with onlySingleAnimalSpecies (app/routes.js:10404-10420). None of those three states is photographed on either side: the captured DR1 panel is two cattle with both outstanding and the captured frontend line is one cow with none saved, so medium confidence is the right band. SECOND PASS, after the states were captured: two frontend states were shot after this finding was written and both are the contrast case. fe-animal-identification-saved is a two-animal cattle line with one record saved, so the open form is the last animal on the line — the exact point where DR1 reads 'Save and finish' — and the frontend reads 'Save and add another'. fe-animal-identification-at-maximum is the same line with both saved, and it shows the at-maximum message with no entry block and no in-card button, which confirms from a picture the narrowing this correction first made from the template. Between those two and fe-animal-identification, which is a single-animal line still offering to add another, the frontend half of the finding is now completely observed and confidence is raised to high. What is still not photographed is DR1's side: the captured DR1 panel remains two cattle with both outstanding, so DR1's no-button single-animal panel and its 'Save and finish' last-animal panel are a source trace at app/routes.js:1707-1723 and nothing more. Both falsifiers are DR1-side and neither has been put to a picture; if one is wanted, the DR1 states to shoot are a one-animal species panel and a two-animal panel with one saved.

relatedTo.why: both are the mechanism of the add-another loop on this page
